c74object.name: tap.discreet~
c74object.digest: The Discreet Music two-machine tape loop
c74object.description: The tap.discreet~ object recreates the two-tape-machine long-delay system from the back cover of Brian Eno's Discreet Music: input is recorded onto tape, spools loop seconds to a playback machine, and returns through a wear path — darken lowpass, bounded drive saturation, DC blocker — into the record head. Unlike an ordinary delay, regen legally reaches 1.0 and sustains, bounded, because every pass is degraded: the forgetting is the stabilizer. Loop changes glide as honest tape-speed doppler; wow and flutter are a deterministic periodic transport; input is the send fader — fade it to zero while the loop sustains and the piece continues without you.

objarg.name: maxloop
objarg.description: Worst-case loop length in seconds (default 30). The tape is bought at DSP start — about 11.5 MB per 30 s at 48 kHz — and bounds the loop attribute.

inlet.digest: Audio input — the send into the record head.

method.name: signal
method.description: Audio to be recorded onto the tape, at the input send level.

method.name: clear
method.description: Erase the tape and the wear state — the eject button. Parameters are kept, and regen-1.0 material is gone for good.

attribute.name: maxloop
attribute.description: Worst-case loop length in seconds (set by the first object argument). Changing it erases the tape when the DSP chain restarts.

attribute.name: loop
attribute.description: Tape span between the machines, in seconds (0.1 up to maxloop). Slewed — and the slew is tape-speed doppler: pitch bends while the transport re-spools, then re-locks. smooth sets the re-spool time.

attribute.name: regen
attribute.description: Return level into the record head (0..1). 1.0 is legal and sustains forever, bounded by the wear path.

attribute.name: darken
attribute.description: Per-pass darkening corner in Hz (20..20000). Every trip through the loop runs through this one-pole lowpass: the tape forgets treble first.

attribute.name: drive
attribute.description: Record-head saturation drive (0 or more). Above zero the loop is absolutely bounded (output can never exceed 1/drive); 0 is an exactly linear path.

attribute.name: input
attribute.description: The send fader: input level into the record head, linear, slewed. The Discreet Music performance move is fading this to zero while the loop sustains.

attribute.name: mix
attribute.description: Dry/wet mix in percent (0..100), equal-power. 0 is bitwise dry, 100 bitwise the playback machine.

attribute.name: wow
attribute.description: Wow as a depth/rate pair: excursion in milliseconds of tape position, rate in Hz (up to 5). Deterministic and periodic; 0 0 parks the transport.

attribute.name: flutter
attribute.description: Flutter as a depth/rate pair — the faster, shallower partner (rate up to 30 Hz).

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Anti-zipper ramp time for the setters in milliseconds (0 = instant). For loop moves this is the re-spool time, and therefore the depth of the doppler bend.
